Substantial | Senior/Staff Software Developer | REMOTE (US) | Contract (potential for full-time)

Substantial is a technology consulting company. I'm looking to add someone to my team working with a long-time client on legal technology. We're a serious, collaborative team working in what we refer to as a Lean/post-agile way. We're looking for someone with 10+ years of experience, ideally in both the front end and the back end.

Technology: Ruby, Rails, Event Sourcing, JavaScript, Stimulus/Turbo Practices: Collaborative development (pairing, mobbing), TDD, end-to-end ownership, UI/UX design, user interviewing, etc.

If you'd like to learn more about how we work, I have several articles on the subject: https://github.com/aaronjensen/software-development/
